why: Reverts initReleaseEventsColumn()'s collection pass to document.querySelectorAll alone. runFilter() REMOVES non-matching rows, so a filter active when the answer lands takes its rows out of the list, and the function never runs again — the rows come back empty for good. name: the populated rows keep their cached text
why: Removes the per-source-row _rowTextCache reset. Even under a FRESH key, testRowMatch() reads the text cached before the answer, which said the column was empty. Must fail on 'C: a fresh key renders the US rows' — the one test no replayed row list can explain.

name: an active filter is not re-run after population
why: Removes the trailing runFilter(). The caches are still dropped, so retyping works — but a user who typed a filter while the fetch was in flight keeps staring at the rows it matched against empty cells. Must fail on 'D: the still-active filter shows the US rows without being retyped'.
